sbar.description: Escalate a problem with a recommendation.
fields: Specific requested action, owner, and timing
sbar.guidance: Keep observations separate from hypotheses. End with the request.

fields: Current risk: stable, concerning, or critical
Current state, impact, and essential history
Risks, warning signs, and if-then contingencies
Receiver restates priorities and accepts ownership
ipass.guidance: Do not treat sending the handoff as acceptance. Confirm ownership on consequential transfers.

fields: What is being done, by whom
Decision, help, or resources required; state none if relevant
can.guidance: Lead with material changes. Avoid a chronological activity log.

fields: Explain why the current course is unsafe
Name the hazard and required stop or escalation
cus.guidance: Use only when an actual safety or high-consequence risk warrants explicit escalation. Not a generic severity label.

methane.description: Share the initial picture of a major incident.
fields: Access constraints, dependencies, or safe intervention path
methane.guidance: This is an engineering adaptation of M/ETHANE; do not imply it is the official emergency-service form.
